definitions.explanation: any beverage sold in a metal can, including soft drinks, coffee, tea, beer, and juice

examples.japanese: {缶飲料|かんいんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{缶飲料|かんいんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}られている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: Canned drinks are sold in vending machines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{缶飲料|かんいんりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧や⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手軽|てがる}→手軽：07176_tegaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}える→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, there is an enormous variety of canned drinks — even coffee and tea can be easily bought in cans.

notes:
Combines ⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧ (can, tin) and ⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧ (beverage, drink). Japan has a particularly rich canned beverage culture, with vending machines offering everything from hot and cold coffee to soup and tea.
